Surfaces.Contract: Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the caller owner before the extension gate wait, through native renewal and local lease changes, and return only after releasing the gate.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-extension-gate

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the outer lock disposal owner while cancelling and joining owned keep-alive. Standalone keep-alive disposal starts its own caller boundary.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-keep-alive-cleanup

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the disposal or acquisition-cleanup caller owner through stopping owned keep-alive and release. Classify swallowed cleanup failures as handled instead of final.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-surrender-cleanup

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the renewal owner through extension and join the lease-deadline task before final publication.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-renewal-deadline
